<a id="euclidean"></a>
## Euclidean Rhythms: `euclidean.yml`

An Afro-Latin percussion piece where six parts each play a note on every sixteenth and Euclidean
rhythms carve the music out of them: the tresillo, the cinquillo, the samba, the bossa nova, then
the same rhythms rotated, then rhythms of twelve and nine steps drifting against the bar, the
shaker's rhythm its track's own and the rest Euclid generators painted on clips.
